complete_text: 10. Wherefore, as the sun passing through the signs, lengthens and shortens the days and hours, so the index of the dial, entering by the points opposite the centre round which the wheel turns, by its daily motions, sometimes in greater, at other times in less periods, will pass through the limits of the months and days. The management of the water, and its equable flow, is thus regulated.
whole_obligations: The sun moves through signs and lengthens/shortens days and hours.
The same dial index enters through points opposite the wheel centre and moves daily, with differing periods.
The whole closing sentence introduces management of water and equable flow; it may not be omitted as mere transition.

Same index, its daily motion and wheel; source10 does not newly assert usual solar depiction, which remains inherited context.
Hours, month, days and unequal periods can be direct content roles; source10 does not fix calendar sizes.
Water management and equable flow must be retained.

nonautomatic_bindings: The old ADJUSTS seasonal type would require explicit season support; daily solar motion is not by itself a named season argument.
The old FROM_HOLE/TO_ANOTHER_HOLE are holes, whereas source10 says points: no automatic alias.
No new EQUINUMEROUS or WHOLE assertion is supplied merely by mentioning periods.
